title: Labor Delta green/red coloring appears on screen and in the PDF; not the CSV
refs: SV-8665 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S9-R7; heading renamed to Labor Delta per SV-9071)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. The Labor Delta column is on and the current tab includes positive and negative Labor Delta values.
steps:
1. Download the current tab as a PDF and look at the Labor Delta values' coloring.
  2. Download the current tab as a CSV and inspect the Labor Delta values.
expected:
1. In the PDF, Labor Delta keeps the green (positive) / red (negative) coloring.
2. In the CSV, the Labor Delta column is monochrome — plain signed numbers with no color or markup.

---
